subject: executor: Refine partition number in hash join v2 (#54304)
summary: Reviewed this commit (vs first parent) in `pkg/executor/join/*` and `pkg/executor/builder.go`: hash join v2 now uses a capped power-of-2 partition count with MSB-based partition routing (`hash >> partitionMaskOffset`) and round-robin build task creation when unbalanced. Checked for partition-index bounds, init ordering (`SetupPartitionInfo()`), concurrency-safety of build paths, and session/runtime correctness; no remaining Blocker/High issues found, and later history doesn’t indicate an unfixed regression from these changes.
